name: Instrument of the Bards (Doss Lute)

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

summary: Each once a day: Fly, Invisibility, Levitate, Protection from Evil and Good, Animal Friendship, Protection From Energy, Protection From Poison.
text: Finer than any ordinary instrument, this one lets a Bard who is playing it cast Protection from Evil and Good, Fly, Levitate and Invisibility, along with its own Protection From Poison, Animal Friendship and Protection From Energy. Each spell can be cast this way once, and every use returns at dawn. When a spell cast through it would inflict the Charmed condition on a target that fails its save, that target makes the save with Disadvantage. Anyone who plays it without being attuned takes 2d4 Psychic damage unless it succeeds on a Wisdom saving throw against DC 15.
